import ControlStack.Deployment.Contracts
open ControlStack.Deployment
namespace SliceInstance
def deployment : IR := ⟨[⟨3,23701,true,false,false⟩,⟨4,23702,true,false,false⟩,⟨5,23704,false,false,false⟩,⟨6,23700,false,false,false⟩,⟨7,23700,false,false,false⟩,⟨8,23703,false,false,false⟩],[⟨3,2,false,true⟩,⟨3,6,false,false⟩,⟨4,6,false,false⟩,⟨5,6,false,false⟩,⟨6,1,true,false⟩,⟨7,1,true,false⟩,⟨7,0,true,false⟩,⟨8,6,false,false⟩],7,6,0,1⟩

#print axioms SliceInstance.facts_refuted
#print axioms ControlStack.Deployment.protocol_safe
#print axioms ControlStack.Deployment.one_use
#print axioms ControlStack.Deployment.gate_contract
#print axioms ControlStack.Deployment.broker_contract
#print axioms ControlStack.Deployment.runtime_exclusive
#print axioms ControlStack.Deployment.deployment_safe
end SliceInstance

namespace SliceInstance
def principals : ControlStack.SC26.Roles := roles deployment 23700 [23704] [23700]
theorem contract_checked (ops : List ControlStack.SC26.Op) (hops : ∀ o ∈ ops, ControlStack.SC26.legal principals o) : ControlStack.SC26.Good principals 1 (ControlStack.SC26.run principals 1 ControlStack.SC26.full ControlStack.SC26.init ops) := protocol_safe principals 1 ops hops
theorem one_use_checked (ops : List ControlStack.SC26.Op) : (ControlStack.SC26.run principals 1 ControlStack.SC26.full ControlStack.SC26.init ops).reserved.Nodup := one_use principals 1 ops
end SliceInstance
#print axioms SliceInstance.contract_checked
#print axioms SliceInstance.one_use_checked
